title: Imported translations use the standard byline: remove the Written by notice, importedLabel and translator
description: Ryan rejected PPY-5faf82 (PR 1655). Byline standard: 'By various bots' or 'By various bots and AUTHOR', produced by the site byline hook from front matter drafting.by AI and author. Remove translation.importedLabel, the Written by twin header, JSON-LD translator. import-translation --written-by becomes front matter author; --drafting-by-ai sets drafting.by AI; notice of an imported translation is only the neutral link to the original. metadata.localization.translation=imported stays record data.
